newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine pension funds managed $5.33 bln end '96.
newsitem.headline: Argentine pension funds managed $5.33 bln end '96.

text.p: Argentina's private pension funds managed $5.33 billion at the end of last year, up from $2.50 billion at the end of 1995, the pension's Superintendency said Friday.
The Superintendency said in a release that, of the funds managed, $2.56 billion, or 48.13 percent of the total were invested in Argentine government bonds.
Stocks accounted for 18.74 percent, or $864 million of funds invested, while fixed term deposits made up $755 million, representing 14.19 percent at the end of 1996.
The remainder of the funds were placed in corporate bonds, foreign bonds, private firms and mutual funds.
The funds held $97 million in cash at the end of December.
Argentina's private pension fund system was introduced in the middle of 1994.
